verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad API across transactions, budgets and spend limits, expenses with receipt upload, payments and vendors, users, onboarding and webhooks, plus card issuance and an official MCP server. That covers many core UI workflows. However, nothing claims or demonstrates full UI parity, API tokens must be created in the dashboard, and several UI features have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim; API coverage of approval-flow and policy-rule configuration, travel booking and accounting setup; programmatic token creation; a published OpenAPI spec at a standard path (all probed paths 404); independent corroboration.
